title: Maple-Glazed Carrots with Ginger and Lemon
summary: Whole slender carrots braised in butter with ginger, maple syrup, lemon zest, thyme and a pinch of cayenne, then reduced uncovered to a sticky glaze and finished with lemon juice.

ingredients.note: halve any thicker than 2 cm lengthwise

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Start the glaze
steps.text: Melt the butter in the pan over medium-high heat and stir in the ginger for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Add the carrots, maple syrup, lemon zest, thyme, salt, cayenne and water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to low and simmer for 12-15 min, turning once, until a knife slides in with a little resistance.

steps.title: Glaze and serve
steps.text: Uncover, raise the heat to medium-high and boil for 3-5 min, rolling the carrots, until the liquid turns to a sticky glaze that coats them. Watch closely at the end, as maple syrup burns quickly. Discard the thyme and zest, add the lemon juice and pepper, and serve.

tips: Carrots of similar thickness cook evenly; halve any fat ones lengthwise.
Orange zest and juice can replace the lemon.
Lovely with roast chicken or as part of a holiday spread.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
